events.continuity_hook: Starts the next fall recruitment episode after the Pacific Northwest trip logistics are no longer active.
events.interaction_goal: Compare open-jaw and round-trip routing, outline the driving sequence, shortlist hotel areas for Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio, flag breakfast and dinner logistics, and identify flight and car holds worth placing.
events.scenario_brief: After completing the Pacific Northwest loop, Tessa starts a mid-September Texas recruitment swing. The draft calendar has Sunday travel from Salt Lake City, Monday North Dallas school visits, a Monday evening fair in Richardson, a Tuesday Fort Worth counselor breakfast, Wednesday Austin high-school appointments, and a Thursday evening San Antonio college night. Dallas and Austin have easier nonstop choices than San Antonio, but round-tripping through Dallas would add a long backtrack at the end. The unresolved pieces are whether to fly open-jaw, how to handle a one-way rental car, and which hotel bases keep early breakfasts and late dinners practical.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Texas loop once event times and return-flight choices become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Rebuild the day-by-day route, compare the Tuesday overnight options, weigh San Antonio versus Austin as the return airport, check one-way car timing, and call out breakfast gaps and late-dinner backups.
events.scenario_brief: The Texas schedule tightens: the Richardson fair now ends at 8:45 p.m., the Fort Worth counselor breakfast check-in is 7:15 a.m., and one Austin school can only meet first thing Wednesday. A late Monday drive all the way to Austin looks risky, but adding a Waco or Temple overnight creates another checkout and morning drive. San Antonio has a workable Friday return with one connection, while returning from Austin is cheaper only if she drives back north after the Thursday evening event. Tessa needs to settle the overnight pattern before hotel holds disappear.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Texas recruitment route from comparison into reservations.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize flights, car pickup and return times, hotel sequence, room details, window-seat requests, parking costs, breakfast timing, dinner backups, cancellation dates, and receipt notes.
events.scenario_brief: The Texas plan is ready for reservations. The likely route is Sunday afternoon Salt Lake City to Dallas, a one-way rental car from DFW to San Antonio, and a Friday early-afternoon San Antonio return with a single comfortable connection. Hotel holds are open for a breakfast-included Richardson room for Sunday and Monday, an Austin-area room for Tuesday after the drive from North Texas, and a San Antonio airport-area room for Wednesday and Thursday with parking clearly listed and restaurants within a short drive. The remaining issue is booking order and making sure the Tuesday hotel does not create a tight Wednesday arrival.

events.continuity_hook: Handles final timing details for the booked Texas recruitment swing.
events.interaction_goal: Set the day-by-day departure timeline, choose breakfast backups, plan dinner after the late fair, confirm checkout and luggage handling, and protect the Friday return-airport buffer.
events.scenario_brief: Eight days before the Texas departure, the San Antonio college night sends a load-in map that moves exhibitor arrival earlier, and the Austin hotel confirms breakfast starts later than Tessa's first campus-adjacent appointment. Flights, car, and rooms are booked. The schedule now needs a tighter Tuesday drive plan, a Wednesday grab-and-go breakfast backup, and a Friday airport timeline that leaves time for fuel, car return, bag drop, and the connection on the way home.

events.continuity_hook: Begins the next fall recruitment loop after the Texas trip is completed.
events.interaction_goal: Compare Chicago round-trip versus Chicago-in and Milwaukee-out routing, estimate drive times, decide whether to keep a rental car throughout, shortlist Oak Brook, Madison, and Milwaukee-area hotels, and note meal logistics and booking deadlines.
events.scenario_brief: A few days after returning from Texas, Tessa opens a late-October upper Midwest counselor loop. The draft has Sunday travel from Salt Lake City to the Chicago area, Monday suburban high-school visits and an evening fair near Oak Brook, Tuesday morning counselor breakfast in Madison, Wednesday Milwaukee high-school appointments, and a Thursday late-afternoon alumni-hosted counselor meetup in Wauwatosa. Flying into Chicago and home from Milwaukee saves backtracking but has fewer afternoon return choices; a Chicago round trip is cheaper but would add a long Thursday night or Friday morning drive. The unresolved pieces are the airport pair, whether a rental car is simpler than trains and rideshares, and hotel bases near suburban venues with realistic meal access.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the upper Midwest loop after event times and hotel availability change.
events.interaction_goal: Rank the return-flight options, set the likely hotel sequence, choose between Madison and Milwaukee overnight bases, identify breakfast backups, check late-arrival dinner access, and list the holds that need action next.
events.scenario_brief: The upper Midwest hosts send updates: the Madison breakfast moves to 7:20 a.m., the Oak Brook fair adds a counselor reception before the floor opens, and the Milwaukee meetup shifts from downtown to a west-side campus venue. The Chicago inbound options still fit a Sunday afternoon departure, but the Milwaukee-to-Salt Lake City Friday choices are either a midday one-stop with a tight morning or a later itinerary with a longer connection. Hotel availability is narrowing in Madison because of a campus event, and Tessa needs to decide whether to prioritize fewer hotel changes or shorter morning drives.
